classification.difficultyReason: Equate the two expressions using the supplied bisector definition and double the recovered half-angle.

spec.description: Rays OA, OB and OC share vertex O on the left. OA rises, OB slopes slightly down, and OC slopes farther down. Two arcs of different radii mark the algebraic sectors; no equality ticks.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source labels and algebraic givens are visible.

answer.worked:
$OB$ bisects $\angle AOC$.
$$\begin{align*}6x-14&=3x+4\\3x&=18\\x&=6\end{align*}$$
$$\begin{align*}\angle AOB&=(6\times6-14)^\circ\\\angle AOB&=22^\circ\\\angle BOC&=(3\times6+4)^\circ\\\angle BOC&=22^\circ\\\angle AOC&=22^\circ+22^\circ\\\angle AOC&=44^\circ\end{align*}$$
